data.title: Jobcenter amendment notice: Bürgergeld recalculated
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen sent an amendment notice (Änderungsbescheid) dated 15 October 2025. Bürgergeld is recalculated because heating cost advances changed, with a monthly total entitlement of €1,126.40 from 1 November 2025. Bank statements are due by 5 November 2025.
data.explanation: Your Bürgergeld for 1 November 2025 to 30 April 2026 was recalculated because your heating cost advances changed. From 1 November 2025 you are entitled to €1,126.40 per month. You must submit your bank statements for the last three months by 5 November 2025. Without them, benefits cannot continue from December. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Jobcenter; the app shows until when. Consider advice from a social counselling service if unsure.

items.title: Submit bank statements
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.
items.action: Submit your bank statements (Kontoauszüge) for the last three months to the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: Without them, benefits cannot continue to be granted from December.

items.title: Objection against the notice
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Jobcenter if you disagree.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.

key_facts.quote: die Leistungen für den Zeitraum 01.11.2025 bis 30.04.2026 werden aufgrund der geänderten

remedy.quote: Der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der im Briefkopf genannten Stelle
